battle.name: 安哥拉獨立戰爭
battle.brief: 一九六一年二月四日，安哥拉人民解放運動在羅安達與本格拉同步動手，把地方衝突推成全國戰爭，葡軍在北部盧達與莫希科山區纏鬥近十四年。卡面這具一八六〇年美軍加特林機槍並未出現在安哥拉戰場，卻以六管旋轉火力的血統，經M134式通用機槍延續到葡軍直升機與武裝車上的反游擊火力網。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 交戰方分三層。第一層是葡萄牙新舊帝國的殖民當局：安哥拉總督代表里斯本政府，之下設安哥拉戰區司令部（CTOAN），指揮第一、第五、第七步兵團、獨立獵兵連、特種作戰與情報排、三個砲兵團，以及配備四十公厘高射砲的海岸砲兵連；國際與國防警察（PIDE）在全國設特別行動隊，負責情報、清剿與特殊作業；空軍與海軍分別以阿魯埃特直升機、第四式教練機與沿岸巡邏艦支援陸軍。第二層是安哥拉本土的三支武裝：安哥拉人民解放運動（MPLA）、以金沙薩為基地、由美國與蒙博托當局支應的安哥拉獨立聯盟（UPA，後稱FNLA），以及一九六六年由若阿斯·薩文比拉起、以薩文比為首的全國解放統一陣線（UNITA）；三者曾於一九六二年底在達累斯薩拉姆組成解放安哥拉全國陣線（FRELIMO），一九六四年聯盟瓦解後由MPLA在戰場上沿用該名稱。第三層是後方與外援：坦尚尼亞與尚比亞提供訓練營與營地，蘇聯自一九七〇年起供應槍械，古巴與中國派出顧問及一批軍火，而剛果（金）與剛果（布）的邊境始終是游擊隊的補給走廊與撤退通道。
countriesEn: The belligerents fell into three layers. The first was the Portuguese colonial state under the Estado Novo: the Governor-General of Angola represented Lisbon, and beneath him sat the Angolan Theatre of Operations Command (CTOAN), which directed the 1st, 5th and 7th Infantry Regiments, the independent rifle companies, the special-operations and intelligence platoons, three artillery regiments, and a coastal artillery battery equipped with 40 mm Bofors guns; the International and State Defence Police (PIDE) ran special-operations detachments nationwide for intelligence, counter-insurgency and 'special operations'; the air force and navy supported the army with Alouette helicopters, T-6 Texan trainers and coastal patrol vessels. The second layer was the three Angolan indigenous movements: the People's Movement for the Liberation of Angola (MPLA); the Union of the Peoples of Angola (UPA, later FNLA), based in Leopoldville and backed by the United States and Mobutu's regime; and the National Union for the Total Independence of Angola (UNITA), raised by Jonas Savimbi in 1966. The three had briefly united in December 1962 as the Front for the Liberation of Angola (FRELIMO) in Dar es Salaam, and after the alliance broke up in 1964 the MPLA kept the FRELIMO name in the field. The third layer was rear area and outside support: Tanzania and Zambia supplied training camps and staging areas, the Soviet Union began shipping weapons from 1970, Cuba and China sent advisers and batches of arms, and the borders of Zaire and Congo-Brazzaville remained the guerrillas' supply corridor and escape route.
people: 關鍵人物橫跨兩邊。安哥拉方面：醫生出身的安哥拉人民解放運動領袖阿戈什蒂紐·內圖在一九六〇年出任主席，一九六三至六四年間在剛果（布）流亡並重建游擊骨幹，一九七四年二月在盧薩卡大會當選解放安哥拉全國陣線主席，一九七五年十一月十一日以國家領導人身分宣告獨立。首任陣線主席愛德華多·蒙達內於一九六九年二月三日在達累斯薩拉姆遇刺身亡，兇手至今未明，一般認為與黨內路線鬥爭有關。策動一九六一年二月四日羅安達奇襲的維里亞圖·達·克魯斯屬解放陣線派，一九六三年被捕後以叛國罪槍決；露西奧·拉拉則長期坐鎮作戰參謀崗位，籌劃北線與卡賓達的行動；馬塞利諾·多斯·桑托斯任陣線書記長，一九七三年與內圖決裂後被撤職。對立一邊，若阿斯·薩文比一九六六年脫離人民解放運動自組全國解放統一陣線，靠游擊戰術與對外宣傳維持存在，直至二〇〇二年陣亡；霍爾登·羅伯圖主持獨立聯盟，一九七〇年代中後期在聯合國與非洲統一組織活動，該組織其後一分為二。葡萄牙方面，安東尼奧·德·斯皮諾拉一九六八至七〇年任安哥拉總督，主持北線改革與有限讓步，一九七四年四月二十五日康乃馨革命後出任總統並主持撤出談判；卡烏爾·施瓦茨作為最後一任海外部長代表葡方在羅安達完成政權交接與撤軍安排。
peopleEn: The key figures spanned both sides. On the Angolan side, Agostinho Neto, a physician by training, became president of the People's Movement for the Liberation of Angola in 1960, spent 1963 and 1964 in exile in Congo-Brazzaville rebuilding the guerrilla core, was elected president of the Front for the Liberation of Angola at the Lusaka congress in February 1974, and declared independence as head of state on 11 November 1975. The first president of the Front, Eduardo Mondlane, was assassinated in Dar es Salaam on 3 February 1969; the killer has never been identified, and the general assumption is that the killing was connected to the internal struggle over line in the movement. Viriato da Cruz, who planned the 4 February 1961 attack on Luanda, belonged to the Liberation Front faction and was captured in 1963 and shot for treason; Lucio Lara ran the operations staff for years, planning campaigns in the northern theatre and in Cabinda; Marcelino dos Santos was the Front's general secretary until his break with Neto in 1973 and his removal. On the other side, Jonas Savimbi left the MPLA in 1966 and founded the National Union for the Total Independence of Angola, keeping the organisation alive through guerrilla craft and external publicity until his death in 2002; Holden Roberto headed the Union of the Peoples of Angola and worked the United Nations and the Organisation of African Unity through the late 1970s, after which that organisation split in two. On the Portuguese side, Antonio de Spinola was Governor-General of Angola from 1968 to 1970, presiding over reform in the north and limited concessions; after the Carnation Revolution of 25 April 1974 he became president and conducted the negotiations for withdrawal; Kaul Schwarz, the last minister of the overseas, represented Portugal in Luanda through the final handover and the evacuation arrangements.
kits: 裝備方面，卡面這具加特林機槍代表的是旋轉砲這條技術線：一八六〇年美國人理查德·加特林設計的六管人力轉動機關，靠六次分發後坐力壓住一個師的正面火力。二十世紀延續這條血統的是電動驅動的M134式通用機槍，有紀錄顯示葡屬非洲末期編制裡，幾內亞與安哥拉的快速反應部隊把這種多管重機槍裝在阿魯埃特第三式直升機上作低空掃射，也裝在武裝車與裝甲車上作路面封鎖與近距離壓制，用密集射擊對付躲入村落與灌木的游擊隊。葡軍常規配裝以德國HK G3與G3A1步槍、英國FN FAL與SLR步槍為骨幹，搭配MG3通用機槍、勃朗寧M2十二點七公厘重機槍、六十與八十一公厘迫擊炮、一二〇公厘榴彈炮、四十公厘波佛高射炮（可車載、亦可作反裝甲直射）以及反坦克地雷。裝甲與運輸以潘哈德AML裝甲車、埃蘭裝甲車、陸虎巡邏車與商用卡車為主，空軍有第四式德州人教練機、菲亞特G.91、CASA C-212與P2V-5海上巡邏機，以及阿魯埃特第二、三式直升機。游擊隊方面，最初大量使用繳獲的G3、MG3與舊式步槍，一九七〇年蘇聯援助到位後轉為蘇式自動步槍、火箭筒與輕型無後坐力炮；對立兩派中，獨立聯盟靠美國供應的北美製步槍與卡車，全國解放統一陣線則在一九七〇年代中期先得中國經尚比亞運來的五六式步槍與迫擊炮，一九八〇年代又得南非供給的FAL步槍與重型機槍。
kitsEn: On equipment, the Gatling gun on the card stands for the technical line of the rotary cannon: the six-barrel hand-cranked mechanism designed by Richard Gatling in the United States in 1860, whose recoil was spread over six discharges and so able to pin down the front of a division. In the twentieth century the direct continuation of that bloodline was the electrically driven M134 general-purpose machine gun, and records show that in the late colonial formations in Portuguese Africa, quick-reaction units in Guinea and Angola fitted multi-barrel heavy machine guns of this kind to Alouette III helicopters for low-level strafing, and to armoured cars and armoured carriers for road blockade and close-range suppression, using dense fire against guerrillas sheltering in villages and scrub. The standard Portuguese loadout was built around the German HK G3 and G3A1 rifles and the British FN FAL and SLR rifles, backed by MG3 general-purpose machine guns, Browning M2 heavy machine guns in 12.7 mm, 60 mm and 81 mm mortars, 120 mm howitzers, 40 mm Bofors guns that could be mounted on trucks or used directly against armour, and anti-tank mines. Armoured vehicles and transport were the Panhard AML armoured car, the Eland armoured car, Land Rover patrol vehicles and commercial trucks, while the air arm flew T-6 Texan trainers, Fiat G.91s, CASA C-212s, P2V-5 Neptune maritime patrol aircraft and Alouette II and III helicopters. On the guerrilla side the first years were fought with captured G3s, MG3s and old rifles; after Soviet aid arrived in 1970 they turned to Soviet automatic rifles, rocket launchers and light recoilless weapons. Of the two rival factions, the FNLA relied on American-supplied North American rifles and trucks, while UNITA first received Chinese Type 56 rifles and mortars routed through Zambia from the mid-1970s, and later South African FAL rifles and heavy machine guns in the 1980s.
tactics: 戰術層面，雙方是一場典型的以弱勝強持久消耗。一九六一年二月四日零時至清晨，解放力量在羅安達同時襲擊二月十四日監獄方向、港口、機場與廣播電台，切斷通訊並奪取物資；同日凌晨本格拉「鐵砧」營遭到攻擊，二月八日一列南部鐵路軍列在卡通貝拉與本格拉之間被伏擊斷線，南方補給動脈一時受挫。游擊隊的基本單位是十餘人的小組，採取晝伏夜襲、破壞公路與橋樑、封鎖隘口、襲擊哨所與巡邏隊的辦法，並在北部盧達與莫希科山區建立後方營地與空投點。葡軍則以「清剿並守住」為原則，用連、伍為搜索單位，配合情報網與警察的特別行動，小組徒步在叢林與河谷中搜索游擊隊，佔領路口設前進支撐點，配一挺四十公厘高射炮與無線電控制十字路，再用阿魯埃特直升機做快速反應與空地封鎖，同時以「村落集中」把散居農民編入受管制的聚居點。大動作包括一九六一至六二年的阿盧維亞納作戰、一九六九至七〇年的迪奧果·卡奧與甘達作戰、一九七〇至七一年的「三叉戟」作戰，以及其後在莫希科與庫安多庫班戈的「阿拉」與「贊比西」作戰。三叉戟一役集中約三千名官兵沿卡賓達至金沙薩通道掃蕩，配空軍轟炸、武裝直升機與裝甲車封路，六個多月裡折損三百四十八人陣亡、近千人受傷，路面被牛車與地雷封死、護衛車隊被各個擊破，是葡軍在整場戰爭中最慘重的失敗。
tacticsEn: Tactically, this was a classic protracted contest of the weak against the strong. In the small hours of 4 February 1961 the liberation forces struck in Luanda at the 14 de Fevereiro prison, the port, the airfield and the radio station, cutting communications and seizing matériel; the fort of Pau de Ferro near Benguela was attacked the same night, and on 8 February a military train on the southern railway was ambushed between Catumbela and Benguela, temporarily strangling the southern supply artery. The guerrilla basic unit was a group of a dozen or so men, working by ambush during the day and by movement at night: breaking roads and bridges, sealing passes, raiding posts and patrols, and establishing rear camps and drop zones in the hills of Lunda and Moxico. The Portuguese answer was to 'clear and hold': companies and sections were the search unit, working with the intelligence network and police special-operations teams, small groups walking the bush and river valleys to find the guerrillas, occupying road junctions with forward support posts, each equipped with a 40 mm Bofors gun and a radio to seal the crossing, while Alouette helicopters provided quick reaction and air-ground blocking; at the same time, villagisation concentrated scattered peasants into controlled settlement points. The large operations included Aluviana in 1961-62, Diogo Cao and Ganda in 1969-70, Tridente in 1970-71, and afterwards Ala in Moxico and Zambeze in Cuando Cubango. Tridente concentrated some three thousand men sweeping the Cabinda-Léopoldville axis, backed by air bombardment, armed helicopters and armoured cars blocking the roads; over six months it cost 348 dead and close to a thousand wounded, with the road sealed by ox carts and mines and convoy escort broken up piecemeal, making it the worst defeat the Portuguese suffered in the whole war.
data: 可核對的數字多出自葡方檔案與後來雙方文獻。時間上，自一九六一年二月四日起，到一九七四年四月二十五日康乃馨革命宣佈停火，最後一批葡萄牙部隊於一九七五年一月二十五日撤出羅安達，全戰爭歷時約十三年十一個月。兵力方面，一九六一年二月行動時解放力量在羅安達的骨幹僅數百人，到一九七〇年代中期估計已達數萬人；葡軍在安哥拉的駐軍高峰時約一萬五千至兩萬人，先後輪派赴安的官兵總數超過五十萬人次。損失方面，葡萄牙官方統計為陣亡八千四百九十六人，其中作戰陣亡二千零七十六人、非作戰死亡六千四百二十人，受傷約二萬五千人，另有約二萬五千人失聯、被俘或逃入剛果（金）；安方長期引用百萬量級的總死亡數字，因戰時統計與醫療記錄缺失而無法核實，學界只承認其中作戰部隊損失遠小於此數。三叉戟作戰自一九七〇年七月一日至一九七一年一月十五日，歷時六個月又四十五天，投入兵力約三千人，葡軍三百四十八人陣亡、約一千人受傷，並損失數十輛卡車與裝甲車。地理上，班加鐵路與洛比托走廊構成葡軍南北補給主軸，公路縱隊在雨季泥濘難行，補給週期常拖長至數週，這正是游擊隊以小股破壞癱瘓後勤的著力點。
dataEn: The verifiable numbers come mostly from Portuguese files and from accounts published later by both sides. On timing: from 4 February 1961 to the ceasefire announced with the Carnation Revolution on 25 April 1974, with the last Portuguese troops leaving Luanda on 25 January 1975, so the war ran about thirteen years and eleven months. On forces: at the time of the February 1961 action the liberation movement had only a few hundred cadres in Luanda, but by the mid-1970s its armed strength is estimated in the tens of thousands; the Portuguese garrison in Angola peaked at roughly fifteen to twenty thousand men, and more than half a million Portuguese servicemen and conscripts passed through Angola over the course of the war. On losses: Portuguese official figures give 8,496 dead, of whom 2,076 were killed in action and 6,420 died of other causes, about 25,000 wounded, and some 25,000 more missing, captured or having fled into Zaire; the Angolan side has long cited a total death toll in the millions, which cannot be verified because wartime records and medical data were lost, and scholarship accepts that the losses of fighting units were far smaller. Tridente ran from 1 July 1970 to 15 January 1971, six months and forty-five days, with some three thousand men committed, 348 Portuguese dead, about a thousand wounded, and the loss of several dozen trucks and armoured vehicles. On geography: the Benguela railway and the Lobito corridor formed the main north-south supply axis of the Portuguese forces; road columns were bogged down in mud during the rains and resupply cycles often stretched to weeks, which was precisely the point at which small-scale sabotage by the guerrillas could paralyse the logistics.
cause: 起事並非單一事件爆發，而是三重條件疊加。其一是帝國的經濟榨取：安哥拉的鑽石由Diamang公司在盧達壟斷經營，咖啡、劍麻與棉花依賴土人勞工，青少年被強迫徵召為苦役，酋長土地被劃為保留區，農民流離失所。其二是政治氛圍：一九六〇年聯合國通過反殖民宣言，同年剛果宣布獨立，布拉柴維爾召開的殖民地人民會議又令安哥拉青年知識分子看到殖民主義可以在一夜之間崩解的先例。其三是內部矛盾：警方情報機關在盧達一帶以普查為名強行遷村、拆散部落，把不滿推成衝突；而解放運動內部因剛果戰事與外來支持分歧而分裂，一九六一年十月在科納克里簽訂的公約雖試圖團結三方，最終仍因美方與蘇方各自扶植不同派系而瓦解。策動者維里亞圖·達·克魯斯企圖以羅安達的襲擊同時打擊通訊、廣播與物資，把原本零散的地方抗爭一次性轉成全國性武裝起義；葡方則把起義定性為受外部支持的共產顛覆，以維持帝國在北大西洋公約與非洲陣營中的戰略位置。
causeEn: The rising did not come from any single event; three conditions overlapped. The first was the economic extraction of the empire: the diamonds of Angola were monopolised by the Diamang company in Lunda, coffee, sisal and cotton depended on African labour, young men were conscripted into forced labour, tribal land was declared native reserve, and peasants were driven off their ground. The second was the political atmosphere: the United Nations adopted its anti-colonial declaration in 1960, Congo declared independence the same year, and the congress of colonial peoples in Brazzaville showed Angolan students and intellectuals a precedent for a colonial order collapsing overnight. The third was internal strain: the police intelligence service moved villages and broke up communities in the Lunda under cover of a census, turning resentment into clashes; and the liberation movement itself split over the Congo fighting and over rival foreign sponsors, so that the Conakry agreement signed in October 1961, which tried to hold the three factions together, dissolved as the American and Soviet patrons each backed a different group. Viriato da Cruz planned the Luanda action to hit communications, broadcasting and matériel at the same moment, converting scattered local grievances into a nationwide armed insurrection in one stroke. The Portuguese, for their part, classified the rising as a communist subversion backed from abroad and fought to keep the empire in the strategic line-up of the Atlantic alliance and of the African bloc.
impact: 影響遠超安哥拉一地。這場戰爭是葡萄牙海外帝國崩塌的終章：一九七四年四月二十五日康乃馨革命之後，葡屬幾內亞已於一九七三年單方面宣布獨立並於一九七四年獲葡方承認，莫三比克於一九七五年六月、維德角與聖多美同年七月先後宣布獨立，東帝汶在一九七五年底被印尼出兵佔領，葡萄牙因此成為歐洲最後一個交出全部殖民地的國家。安哥拉本身則從反殖民戰爭一步滑入長達二十七年的內戰：一九七五年起古巴以「薩瓦納」名義出兵，美國與南非分別支持兩支反對派武裝，冷戰在非洲的代理戰場於是成形，一九八七至八八年的奎托·庫阿納瓦萊攻防戰被視為轉折點，直至二〇〇二年四月二日《盧埃納備忘錄》簽署才真正收場，戰爭時長在世界紀錄上僅次於敘利亞與阿富汗。對軍事的教訓同樣具體：以卡車、短程直升機與旋轉重機槍構成的火力小組，面對分拆成十餘人、隨時隱入村落與叢林的游擊隊，射程與持續火力都不是關鍵，決定勝負的是後勤週期、佔領點的守備與政治上的持久耐性。葡軍回國後海外部隊解散，兵役制度與兵員結構被迫重整，一九七六年新憲法取消海外領土，軍隊在本土防衛與政治角色之間長期掙扎。
impactEn: The consequences reached far beyond Angola. This war was the last chapter of the collapse of the Portuguese overseas empire: after the Carnation Revolution of 25 April 1974, Portuguese Guinea had already proclaimed independence unilaterally in 1973 and was recognised by Portugal in 1974, Mozambique followed in June 1975, Cape Verde and Sao Tome in July of the same year, and East Timor was occupied by Indonesian forces at the end of 1975, leaving Portugal the last European country to hand over its entire colonial possession. Angola itself slid from a war of decolonisation into twenty-seven years of civil war: from 1975 Cuba intervened under the name of Operation Savannah, while the United States and South Africa each backed one of the armed opposition factions, turning the country into a Cold War proxy theatre; the battles of Cuito Cuanavale in 1987-88 are taken as the turning point, and the war did not truly end until the Luena Memorandum of 2 April 2002, making it one of the longest conflicts on record after Syria and Afghanistan. The military lesson is equally concrete: firepower groups built from trucks, short-range helicopters and rotary heavy machine guns, facing guerrillas broken into groups of a dozen who could vanish into villages and scrub at will, were not decided by range or by volume of fire but by the length of the logistics cycle, by the security of forward posts and by political endurance. After the return home the overseas forces were disbanded, conscription and the structure of the army had to be rebuilt, and the 1976 Constitution abolished the overseas territories, leaving the armed forces to struggle for a long time between homeland defence and a political role.
result: 結果分三層看。軍事上，解放力量始終未能奪取羅安達、盧邦戈與卡賓達的主要城市，也沒有能力在正面消滅葡軍主力，但它把一場殖民當局與游擊隊之間的消耗賽拖成曠日持久的僵持，終於在政治層面先行得分：一九七五年一月十五日《阿爾沃爾協議》在阿爾維爾簽訂，規定三派共管過渡政府並逐步交權，葡萄牙於同年一月二十五日完成撤軍，十一月十一日由內圖代表安哥拉人民解放運動單方面宣告獨立，成立安哥拉人民共和國。政治上只有人民解放運動得到國際普遍承認，獨立聯盟與全國解放統一陣線被排除在國家機器之外，前者在一九七〇年代末分裂，後者在南非與美國支援下成為長期抵抗力量，反過來把新國家拖回內戰。技術上，加特林機槍所代表的一八六〇年旋轉砲本身從未出現在安哥拉戰場，但它血統上的後裔M134式通用機槍在七十年代葡軍的直升機與武裝車上成為反游擊火力網的標誌；整場戰爭的結果也說明，旋轉砲所代表的絕對火力，面對沒有固定陣線、沒有補給線的游擊隊時，最後並不是靠多幾管砲管取勝，而是靠誰能更久地留在戰場上。
resultEn: The outcome reads on three levels. Militarily, the liberation forces never took the main cities of Luanda, Lubango or Cabinda, and never managed to destroy the Portuguese army in open battle; but they turned a war of attrition between the colonial authorities and the guerrillas into a grinding stalemate and finally won the political round first: the Alvor Agreement was signed at Alvor in the Algarve on 15 January 1975, providing for a transitional government shared by the three movements and a phased handover of power, Portugal completed its withdrawal on 25 January of the same year, and on 11 November Neto declared independence on behalf of the MPLA alone, establishing the People's Republic of Angola. Politically, only the MPLA obtained broad international recognition; the FNLA and UNITA were locked out of the state machine, the former splitting in the late 1970s and the latter becoming a long-term resistance force backed by South Africa and the United States, which in turn dragged the new state back into civil war. Technologically, the 1860 rotary cannon represented by the Gatling gun never appeared on an Angolan battlefield, but its descendant, the M134 general-purpose machine gun, became a hallmark of the Portuguese counter-insurgency fire net mounted on helicopters and armoured cars in the 1970s; the result of the whole war also shows that the absolute firepower represented by the rotary cannon, when faced with a guerrilla force that had no fixed line and no supply line, was not won by having a few more barrels but by whoever could remain on the battlefield longer.
